description: InHouse Print Database Query Tools - Direct SQL queries on Fred production database (SQL Server). Fred is the business platform name for the in-house print production system. Query orders, job tickets, clients, materials, and production data. Connection: SQL Server via inhouse_execute_sql() wrapper. Note: For guided queries with schema validation, use inhouse_print platform tools instead (inhouse_execute_sql, inhouse_get_query_library_catalog).

tools.name: inhouse_execute_query
tools.short_description: Execute custom SQL on Fred print shop database - orders, jobs, clients, production
tools.description: Execute custom SQL query on Fred InHouse print shop database (SQL Server). Query orders, jobs, clients, and production data.

query.description: SQL query to execute on Fred database. MUST use SQL Server syntax: TOP N (not LIMIT), ? placeholders (not %s), DATEADD() for dates, GETDATE() for current date. Case-insensitive LIKE search by default.

params.description: List of values for ? placeholders in query (in order). Example: ['CJ King', '2025-01-01'] for WHERE ClientName = ? AND OrderDate > ?

max_rows.description: Maximum rows to return (default 100, max 1000). Prevents token overflow.

read_only.description: If true, only SELECT queries allowed. Set false for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (requires explicit permission).

truncated.description: True if results limited by max_rows

examples.name: Find orders by client name
examples.code:
fred_execute_query(
  query='SELECT TOP 20 * FROM Orders WHERE ClientName LIKE ? ORDER BY OrderDate DESC',
  params=['%CJ King%']
)
examples.description: Search for orders from client with 'CJ King' in name. Returns most recent 20 orders.

examples.name: Get job tickets for specific order
examples.code:
fred_execute_query(
  query='''
    SELECT jt.*, ps.[Desc] as PaperSize, bt.BindTypeDesc
    FROM JobTickets jt
    LEFT JOIN PaperSize ps ON jt.PaperSizeID = ps.SizeID
    LEFT JOIN BindType bt ON jt.BindTypeID = bt.BindID
    WHERE jt.OrderID = ?
  ''',
  params=[56230]
)
examples.description: Get all job tickets for order 56230 with paper size and binding type

examples.name: Find urgent unpaid orders
examples.code:
fred_execute_query(
  query='''
    SELECT TOP 50
      o.OrderID, o.ClientName, o.OrderDate, o.DateRequired,
      COUNT(jt.TicketID) as JobCount,
      SUM(jt.Cost) as TotalCost
    FROM Orders o
    LEFT JOIN JobTickets jt ON o.OrderID = jt.OrderID
    WHERE o.Urgent = 1 AND o.Invoiced = 0
    GROUP BY o.OrderID, o.ClientName, o.OrderDate, o.DateRequired
    ORDER BY o.DateRequired
  '''
)
examples.description: Get all urgent orders not yet invoiced, with job count and total cost

examples.name: Search clients by email domain
examples.code:
fred_execute_query(
  query='SELECT ClientID, ClientName, Email FROM Clients WHERE Email LIKE ?',
  params=['%@cjking.com.au']
)
examples.description: Find all clients with email addresses from cjking.com.au domain

examples.name: Get recent orders by date range
examples.code:
fred_execute_query(
  query='''
    SELECT TOP 100 *
    FROM Orders
    WHERE OrderDate >= ? AND OrderDate < ?
    ORDER BY OrderDate DESC
  ''',
  params=['2025-11-01', '2025-12-01']
)

examples.name: Find jobs with specific finishing options
examples.code:
fred_execute_query(
  query='''
    SELECT jt.TicketID, jt.ShortJobDesc, o.ClientName
    FROM JobTickets jt
    INNER JOIN Orders o ON jt.OrderID = o.OrderID
    WHERE jt.FrontCelloGloss = 1
    ORDER BY jt.TicketID DESC
  ''',
  max_rows=50
)
examples.description: Find jobs with front gloss cello lamination

common_mistakes: ❌ Status column does NOT exist (use Invoiced instead)
❌ TotalCost column does NOT exist (sum JobTickets.Cost instead)
✅ Use Invoiced to check if paid (boolean 1/0)
common_queries: SELECT TOP 20 * FROM Orders WHERE ClientName LIKE '%keyword%' ORDER BY OrderDate DESC
SELECT * FROM Orders WHERE Urgent = 1 AND Invoiced = 0
SELECT * FROM Orders WHERE DateRequired >= GETDATE() AND DateRequired <= DATEADD(day, 7, GETDATE())

common_mistakes: ❌ PrintType column does NOT exist (use finishing flags instead)
✅ Cost is per-ticket, not order total
✅ TicketNotes contains full specs and customer delivery info
common_queries: SELECT jt.*, ps.[Desc] as PaperSize FROM JobTickets jt LEFT JOIN PaperSize ps ON jt.PaperSizeID = ps.SizeID WHERE jt.TicketID = ?
SELECT * FROM JobTickets WHERE ShortJobDesc LIKE '%business cards%' OR TicketNotes LIKE '%business cards%'
SELECT * FROM Clients WHERE ClientName LIKE '%keyword%'
SELECT * FROM Clients WHERE Email LIKE '%@domain.com'

sql_server_syntax.limit: Use TOP N (not LIMIT): SELECT TOP 20 * FROM Orders
sql_server_syntax.placeholders: Use ? (not %s or $1): WHERE ClientName = ? AND OrderDate > ?
sql_server_syntax.dates: Use DATEADD, GETDATE, CONVERT: WHERE OrderDate > DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE())
sql_server_syntax.like: Case-insensitive by default: WHERE ClientName LIKE '%printing%'
sql_server_syntax.boolean: Use bit (1/0): WHERE Invoiced = 1 AND Urgent = 0
sql_server_syntax.reserved_words: Use square brackets: SELECT [Desc] FROM PaperSize

common_joins: JobTickets → BindType: ON jt.BindTypeID = bt.BindID (LEFT JOIN - nullable)

tips: ✅ Use TOP N for limiting results (not LIMIT)
✅ Use ? placeholders (SQL Server syntax, not PostgreSQL %s)
✅ Orders.Invoiced is boolean (1/0), not 'Status' text field
✅ JobTickets.Cost is per-ticket, not order total
✅ Use LIKE '%keyword%' for partial text search (case-insensitive)
✅ Use DATEADD() for date math: DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE())
✅ Use square brackets for reserved words: [Desc]
✅ TicketNotes contains full job specs, ShortJobDesc is brief summary
✅ LEFT JOIN BindType (nullable), INNER JOIN Orders (required)

database_context.name: Fred InHouse Print Shop Database
database_context.purpose: Production print shop management - orders, jobs, customers, materials
key_features: JobTickets: Individual print jobs with full specifications
Materials: Paper sizes, types, GSM, binding types
Production: Job stages, types, shipping methods
important_notes: ⚠️ Orders.Status column does NOT exist - use Invoiced (boolean)
⚠️ Orders.TotalCost column does NOT exist - sum JobTickets.Cost
⚠️ JobTickets.PrintType column does NOT exist - use finishing flags
✅ Cost is per-ticket in JobTickets, not order total
✅ TicketNotes contains full specs, ShortJobDesc is brief
✅ Urgent flag is at Order level (boolean 1/0)
✅ Lookup tables use [Desc] or BindTypeDesc for names
